title: Bolden's decline and how his music differed from Robichaux's
summary: He recalls Bolden going crazy, and says the Bolden band played rough music unlike Robichaux's, and the two were not hired by the same club on one night.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: They had a real nice, nice birthday out there. They had a real stage there. And the orchestra was down in the, you know, in front of the pit. Yeah, the pit down there and stayed up above them. They stayed down there. You turned to the link up there? Yeah. Was the Johnson part the same way? No, no, no. I never had no show. Would you say Buddy Baldwin was a big name too? Oh yeah, before he was shot down there. I remember him. Yeah. All that clear. Do you remember when he went crazy? Do you remember him going crazy? I mean... I remember, I can't tell the time, but when they were, I was in my time. I remember that. Yeah. I remember twenty-half months. Yeah. What did he do? I mean... He blew himself really good. He lost his mind. He lost his mind. He lost his mind. Did he start like a... I wanna... How he went crazy? Like a... What he started doing?
Yeah, what did he start to do when he went crazy? Did you know?
No, no, no. You just heard he went crazy?

Yeah. He didn't know you used to play around the band. I was like, fuck, they used to play all over. You were going to just play. Mm-hmm. But they used to play all of the little halls downtown. They had better little halls, little clubs and things all downtown. What was the difference between the music Buddy Bolden's band played and the Rubbish Olds band played? Were they almost the same or... No, no, they were all a lot different. All rough different. No, no, no. They were all a lot different. The Rubbish Olds band played with all the bassists band played with them. But the Bowling was playing with them. Rough music. Rough music. Yeah.

Would the same club hire the two different bands ever? Huh? Would they hire the two bands... The same club, the same society has the two different bands. Not at the same time. Not at the same type of band. No.
